name: SiteNav - No Current Page
description: The nav on a page that is not in the menu at all — a CMS-authored page like /a-day-in-the-life, which the site already ships several of. Every link stays muted and none carries aria-current. This is the negative half of the current-page match and the state an over-matching comparison breaks: collapsing the site root to an empty string, or degrading the match into a prefix test, would ink a link on a page the visitor is not on. The Default scenario proves the highlight appears; this one proves it stays away.
